definitions.explanation: Not needed or serving no purpose; in set phrases, there is no need for something.

definitions.gloss: not allowed; to be avoided (on notices and in set phrases)
definitions.explanation: Used in fixed phrases and on notices to mean that something must not be done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧{無用|むよう}だ。
{無用|むよう}な⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けたい→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to avoid needless conflict.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}かなく→弾く：02444_hiku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無用|むよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長物|ちょうぶつ}だ。
examples.english: The old piano nobody plays anymore is now just taking up space.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問答無用|もんどうむよう}→問答無用：17316_mondoumuyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{追|お}い{返|かえ}された→追い返す：18691_oikaesu⟧。
examples.english: I was sent away with no chance to argue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{天地無用|てんちむよう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: The box said "This side up," so I was careful which way I carried it.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧{無用|むよう}: no need to worry
- ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無用|むよう}だ: there's no need to hold back
- {無用|むよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長物|ちょうぶつ}: a useless thing that only takes up space, a white elephant
- ⟦{問答無用|もんどうむよう}→問答無用：17316_mondoumuyou⟧: no arguing; without discussion

WATCH OUT:
{天地無用|てんちむよう} on a parcel means 'do not turn upside down' (literally 'top and bottom: reversing not allowed'), not 'either way up is fine'. Many Japanese speakers misread it too.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧: unnecessary (neutral, everyday)
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧: wasteful, pointless
